name: Chiyo
description: A soratami leader who hunts Toshi and is destroyed by Night's Reach.

description_citations.text: "Toshiro Umezawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi is briefly captured by orochi led by Sosuke, and then tormented by dreams from Uyo and Chiyo confronting him with his misdeeds.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chiyo mortally wounds Toshi; Night's Reach saves and teleports him to Dominaria, blinding him on Madara.
timeline.quote: She drops off Toshi on Madara and blinds him.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Michiko speaks with Mochi at Minamo, learning what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, as Toshi learns the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks Minamo.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly the academy is rocked as Hidetsugu attacks.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi accidentally interrupts a parley and defeats two soratami; Chiyo's party then waits at his home.
timeline.quote: The moonfolk tried to kill him, but he defeated them with the help of his kanji magic.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Toshi defeats Chiyo and releases the oni-dog, which destroys much of Otawara.
timeline.quote: He fought and defeated Chiyo, then released Hidetsugu's oni-dog from the tile to destroy much of Otawara.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chiyo stabs Toshi; Night's Reach forgives him and Chiyo is destroyed.
timeline.quote: Once more, Toshi swore his allegiance to her and so Chiyo was destroyed.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Sends Toshi dreams and later mortally wounds him, wearing a mask after being mauled.

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A soratami who attacked Toshi and has her face mauled by an oni.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
